name: rag-webchat
description: Embeddable webchat AI agent with RAG on AWS

scripts.deploy:site:dev: npm exec -w infra -- cdk deploy -c stage=dev RagWebchat-dev-Site
scripts.setup:github-deploy: aws cloudformation deploy --region eu-central-1 --stack-name RagWebchat-GitHubDeploy --template-file infra/github/deploy-role.yaml --capabilities CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM && aws cloudformation describe-stacks --region eu-central-1 --stack-name RagWebchat-GitHubDeploy --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='RoleArn'].OutputValue" --output text
